about_the_game:
Game Content

In the game, you are a hotel guest and the receptionist falls in love with you. She will hide in various places waiting to surprise you,

As a guest, you just want to rest well to relieve the fatigue of daytime work, so what you need to do is to search every part of the room. Once you find her in the room, leave immediately. If you confirm that she is not in the room, close the window and lock the door.

If you persist in not being caught by the waiter for a certain number of days, you can clear the customs.

Immersive Gaming Experience

Experience realistic scenes and thrilling sound effects, and as the game progresses, the tense atmosphere becomes increasingly intense. Every detail keeps you alert at all times.

Unpredictable Location

The location where the receptionist hides each time is random, so even if you play repeatedly, you can have a different gaming experience.

Different Coping Strategies

Different hiding positions require different coping strategies. While overcoming psychological fears, it is necessary to focus and react quickly.

Variable Attire

As the game progresses, in order to better distract your attention, the receptionist will make corresponding adjustments to their clothing. Can you concentrate without being distracted and ultimately become a real man?

Besides, there is a small Easter egg buried in the game, can you discover it?

short_description: Real Man Hotel is a psychological horror game where you are being pursued by the hotel receptionist. Your goal is to avoid being caught by her, otherwise... your body may not be able to withstand it. The game does not contain any scary scenes, so even the timid can play.
